arguments.content:
## Primary Cause

The primary cause of the revenue drop on day 2 (2025-03-11) compared to day 1 (2025-03-10) was the implementation of a 15% discount on all products. This discount significantly reduced the net revenue per order, particularly affecting high-value items like the ELEC-4K-TV-001 and APPL-IPAD-AIR.

## Dollar Impact

The dollar impact of the 15% discount can be calculated by comparing the total net revenue on day 1 versus day 2. On day 1, the total net revenue was $8,499.90, while on day 2, it dropped to $4,460.49. This represents a decrease of $4,039.41 in net revenue.

## Recommendation

To mitigate the negative impact of the discount, consider implementing a tiered discount system. This would allow for higher discounts on lower-priced items while maintaining competitive pricing on high-value products. For example, a 20% discount on items under $100 and a 10% discount on items between $100 and $500 would help balance the revenue while still providing value to customers.
